reviews.title: FLUFFY
reviews.comment: ITS SUPER FLUFFY AND GETS THE JOB DONE I LOVE IT SO MUCH. It fits a lil tight but it stays on perfectly fine, feels good quality and definitely worth the money for this one.
reviews.author: Magikal

reviews.title: I like the quality
reviews.comment: The YOUSHARES QuadCast Mic Windscreen is an affordable accessory ,it was a good product.
reviews.author: Vaseleine Thermitus

reviews.title: This + Fifine 6 Mic = Purfect
reviews.comment: I was a bit hesitant on ordering this for my Fifine Tank6 mic but I pulled the trigger and it fits perfectly! The setup was easy and doesn’t slip from the mic. Worth the price. Stops my loud pops with ease. I do wish it had a black strap instead of a white line around the mic.
reviews.author: Frank Jay Ferrer

reviews.title: Fluffy
reviews.comment: It seems good quality for the price, blocks out all wind noise from fans, and muffles my mechanical keyboard and mouse clicks from being picked up in my microphone. Also, I used this on my 512 Audio Skylight not the quadcast microphone.
reviews.author: Mason
